name: Stable Mint USD
oneLiner: USDSM is Stable mint Ltd's dollar token, backed by cash and liquid financial assets and redeemable at par after holder onboarding.
collateral: Issuer-disclosed U.S. dollar cash deposits and high-quality liquid financial assets; current banks, asset weights and independently reconciled backing are undisclosed
pegMechanism: Legal-person participants mint against received USD deposits; legal and natural holders can request par USD redemption after AML/KYC onboarding. Etherlink is the primary deployment, with LayerZero V2 burn-and-mint interoperability across Ethereum, Base and Arbitrum.

proofOfReserves.provider: Stable mint Ltd; 102% reserve claim without retrieved dated reserve-to-liability reconciliation
